tagline: BEARER HOLDER FOR HEIGHT-ADJUSTABLE PEDESTAL SYSTEM FOR RAISED DECKING FLOORING
summary: SikaRoof® VersiJack® Bearer Holder Single Wing is an accessory used to connect timber joists to the pedestal for receiving decking boards. Bearer holders are manufactured from recycled polypropylene (PP), and it has a single wing to allow screwing into a timber joist. SikaRoof® VersiJack® Bearer Holder Single Wing is used in conjunction with SikaRoof® VersiJack® and timber joists, and is installed between the pedestal and the joists with the timber screws.
